objectives.text: Speak with Mayor Orrin in the big blue-roofed house
Find Ranger Willa in the Whispering Wood (the path in the north-west)
Cut through the brambles and reach the Old Oak Grove
Speak with Ranger Willa in the grove
Bring the Warden's Seal to Mayor Orrin
Speak with Elder Mahina in the village
Find Lani in the Hollow Cave north of the village
Enter the Hollow Cave north of the village

actions.text: The Hooded Leader falls to one knee, laughing under the mask.
It is done. The gate is open, and you are the key. The Whole thanks you.
The air above the square tears like cloth. A whirl of violet light drags at your feet...
You climb out into the daylight. Black smoke is rising over the village!
Shouts and the clash of steel carry on the wind. Hurry back to the square!
SkyBourne Saga
actions.sub: Those born of the sky will shape reality itself.

actions.text: On a small island in a faraway sea, a legend is about to be born.
A young swordsman, with no past and no future, has come to seek his fortune.
But every legend starts somewhere small. Today, that somewhere is Paradise Island.
End of the line, friend. This is my last stop for the day.
Suits me. I need to try an earn some money anyway.
Ha! What does a swordsman want on Paradise Island, anyway? Nothing here but fishermen and Trees.
I'm not really sure, but something tells me this is where I need to be... for now.
Ahh, a man who lets the sea be his guide, I can relate to that.
If it's work you're after, the mayor has been asking about  lately swordsmen. Big blue-roofed house, up the hill past the plaza. You can't miss it.
I'll check it out. Thanks for the tip, Osk.
Up the hill, past the fountain, the mayor's blue-roofed house watches over the harbour. Whatever he wants, it won't be a quiet job.
Alright, Let's see what this Orrin guy has to say. Hopefully its a job, and maybe a meal would be nice.
Move with WASD or the arrow keys (Shift to run), or click the ground. Press E to talk. Find Mayor Orrin.
The gargoyle crumbles to gravel. Behind its pedestal, a hollow holds a sealed cache.
You find

npcs.name: Ferryman Osk
npcs.title: Ferry
npcs.line: The ferry runs whenever the tide allows. Walk to the end of the pier when you want to head back to the colosseum.

npcs.name: Elder Mahina
npcs.title: Village Elder
npcs.line: Welcome to Paradise Island. The mayor lives in the big blue-roofed house up the hill; he has been asking after a stranger who can fight.

npcs.name: Pua
npcs.title: Fisher
npcs.line: Biting well today. Don't tell the gulls.

npcs.name: Kai
npcs.title: Island Trader
npcs.line: Coconuts, shells, and rumours from the mainland. The rumours are free. The crates on the beach are the harbour's; I'd leave them be.

npcs.name: Old Tane
npcs.title: Farmer
npcs.line: Turnips, beans and one very stubborn goat. The goblins have been at my fence ever since they moved into the Whispering Wood.

actions.text: Welcome to the Salty Anchor. A hot meal and a warm bed, on the house for anyone who looks as beaten as you do.

npcs.name: Harbourmaster Teo
npcs.title: Harbourmaster
npcs.line: Mind the boats. The big ferry from the colosseum comes in at the long pier; mine are the little ones.

npcs.name: Scholar Nema
npcs.title: Lore keeper
npcs.line: The Hollow Cave is older than the colosseum, older than the ladder. The tunnel behind me goes down to a flooded court.

actions.text: A fighter, at last. I am Orrin, mayor of this island. Listen closely: the Hollow Cave north of the village has been sealed by order of the council, and the Warden's Seal that opens it is gone.
Ranger Willa carried the Seal into the Whispering Wood to deal with a goblin raiding party that kept robbing the farms. That was three days ago. She has not come back.
Take the path in the north-west corner of the island. Fight your way through, find Willa, and bring the Seal home. I will make it worth your while.
Any sign of Willa? The Whispering Wood is in the north-west. Follow the path past the farm. Goblins and worse live in there, so bring your whole party.
The Warden's Seal! And Willa is safe? You have done this island a great service.
Take this purse, and my blessing. The council's order is lifted: the Cave Warden will let you through the gate.
The cave is open to you now. The old tales say a drowned king sleeps at the bottom of it. Do not wake him lightly.
Halt. The tunnel is sealed by order of the council, and the rockfall will not move without the Warden's Seal.
Mayor Orrin knows more. His house is the big one with the blue roof.
The Seal has been returned and the council's order lifted. The rockfall has been cleared.
Beyond this arch the old crypt begins. Restless guardians wander it, and at its heart a drowned king keeps his throne. Bring your whole party.
So the Seal is home and the gate is open. You have done the island a great service, traveller.
There is one more thing. Young Lani slipped into the Hollow Cave three days ago, before the council sealed it, to gather moonglow moss. She has not come back.
The cave runs deep: at its end lies the crypt of the old drowned king, and his court still keeps it. Please. Bring her home.
The Hollow Cave is north of the village, past the old ruins. Lani is not foolish, only stubborn. Please hurry.
Lani is safe, but those masked men are in my village! Stop them, I beg you!
Fresh meat! The boss said someone would crawl out of that hole.
Take the stranger, take the village, take it all!
You cut down my brother? Then you will not leave this square alive!
Enough. You are stronger than you look. Good. The gate will need a strong key.
I slipped out through the side tunnel. Thank you for facing the king for me!
Those masks came out of the sea fog. Please, protect the village!
Ah, a pair of strong arms! A storm took my best net two days ago, and the current swept it up the stream into the Whispering Wood.
It is tangled somewhere by the water. I would go myself, but the goblins and I have... a history. Fetch it and I will make it worth your while.
My net should be snagged by the water somewhere in the Whispering Wood. Follow the stream, friend.
That is her! Not a single hole. You are a marvel!
Pua presses a reward into your hands
Mind where you step! A great goblin brute has been smashing my fence every night. Chewed through two of my goats' fence posts and half a turnip row.
He camps by the broken fence to the south, if you can call it a camp. Knock some sense into him and I'll make it worth your while.
Brute's by my broken fence. Don't let him eat the goat.
Gone! Quiet at last. Here, this is what the village keeps for its heroes.
Old Tane's thanks
You! You the one the old man sent? Ha! I'll break you like I broke his fence!
I am cataloguing the moon-glyphs, the old script on the cave walls. Three torn pages from the first survey were scattered when the expedition fled.
One blew down near the cave path. The other two are somewhere in the Whispering Wood. Bring them to me, please, and I will see you rewarded.
Still missing pages. One near the cave path, two in the Whispering Wood.
All three! Look at the ligatures! This confirms everything. Please, take this with my thanks.
Nema's reward
A hundred gold a throw, high roll takes the pot. Ties give your coin back.
Four hundred a throw. Come to lose it, or come to win it.
The statue's eyes open. Grit pours from its jaw. 'INTRUDER.'
The path narrows between ancient trunks, and the sea-wind dies away. Something rustles in the leaves ahead.
NORTH-WEST: the Whispering Wood. Goblins have been seen on the trail. TRAVELLERS GO ARMED.
NORTH: the Hollow Cave. The council has sealed it. WEST: the forest path, the farm and the harbour. SOUTH: the village.
THE TIDE GIVES, THE TIDE TAKES. DRINK, REST, AND PAY THE SEA ITS DUE.
Cold air breathes out of the dark. The tunnel slopes down into the Hollow Cave.
You cast a line off the pier and wait.
A page of strange glyphs is pinned under a stone by the path. One of Nema's.
